newsitem.title: USA: U.S. police investigate letter in JonBenet case.
newsitem.headline: U.S. police investigate letter in JonBenet case.

text.p: Police investigating the murder of six-year-old beauty pageant winner JonBenet Ramsey said Thursday they wanted to talk to the author of an anonymous letter that contained potentially significant information about the case.
The letter was sent from Shreveport, Louisiana, in late January, according to a statement released by the authorities in Boulder, Colorado.
Boulder authorities have asked police in Shreveport for help in locating the person who wrote the letter, one of 600 received by police on the Ramsey murder.
Police spokesman Kelvin McNeill declined to disclose any information about the letter.

The beauty pageant winner's body was found by her father on Dec. 26 in a windowless basement room in the family's home in Boulder about eight hours after her mother said she discovered a ransom note demanding $118,000.
The child was strangled and according to published reports was also sexually assaulted. No arrests have been made and no suspects named in the six-week-old investigation.
